title: EnableVATS - InputEnableLayer
content:
Member of: InputEnableLayer Script Enables or disables the player's ability to use VATS on this layer. Syntax: Function EnableVATS(abEnable = true) native Parameters: - abEnable: If true, enables VATS. Otherwise disables it. Default: True Return Value: None. Examples: ; Enable VATS myLayer.EnableVATS()
; Disable VATs InputEnableLayer myLayer = InputEnableLayer.Create() myLayer.EnableVATS(false) See Also: - InputEnableLayer Script - IsVATSEnabled - InputEnableLayer
